checks.lead: Grand Duchess Anastasia Nikolaevna of Russia (Russian: Анастасия Николаевна, romanized: Anastasiya Nikolayevna; 18 June [O.S. 5 June] 1901 – 17 July 1918) was the fourth child and youngest daughter of Tsar Nicholas II, the last sovereign of Imperial Russia, and his wife, Tsarina Alexandra Feodorovna.
